title: Which applications support tenant profiles, and what each profile identifies

prose.text: Which applications a profile can be created for depends on whether you ask the console or the API, and they differ.

prose.label: How that is stored.
prose.text: {{shared-item-members}} Which `itemType` token each Help field maps to is not published, and only Microsoft has a confirmed pairing, in [[zia.tenant-profiles.microsoft]] {{gap:item-type-per-app}}.

The AI & ML rule flow, where ChatGPT profiles surface in the rule UI, is covered in [[zia.cloud-app-control.ai-ml-rules]]. Per-application options and traps: [[zia.tenant-profiles.app-specifics]]. Caps per application: [[zia.tenant-profiles.limits]]. Wire format: [[zia.tenant-profiles.api-surface]].

api-app-enum.statement: The API `appType` accepts sixteen values: YOUTUBE, GOOGLE, MSLOGINSERVICES, SLACK, BOX, FACEBOOK, AWS, DROPBOX, WEBEX_LOGIN_SERVICES, AMAZON_S3, ZOHO_LOGIN_SERVICES, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PLATFORM, ZOOM, IBMSMARTCLOUD, GITHUB and CHATGPT_AI. Both SDKs and the Terraform provider carry the field as a plain string.

no-claude-docusign-token.statement: No API `appType` value exists for Claude or Docusign, so an API, SDK or Terraform client cannot name them in the sixteen-value list. Do not infer `CLAUDE_AI` or `DOCUSIGN` from the Help labels.
no-claude-docusign-token.conditions: Absence from the captured OpenAPI enum and the SDK docstring list. A newer API version may add them.

shared-item-members.statement: A profile's identifiers are stored in the same API members whatever the application: `itemTypePrimary` and `itemDataPrimary`, `itemTypeSecondary` and `itemDataSecondary`, plus `itemValue` for YouTube categories.

help-vs-api-apps.summary: Which applications a tenant profile can be created for

quotes: To configure a tenant profile for Docusign
To configure a tenant profile for Claude

positions.says: The Help form offers Claude and Docusign, and does not mention Box, Facebook or Amazon S3.
The API enum has BOX, FACEBOOK and AMAZON_S3, and no Claude or Docusign value.

help-vs-api-apps.impact: An automation built from the API enum cannot create the Claude or Docusign profiles the console offers, and a console-only reading hides three API values (BOX, FACEBOOK, AMAZON_S3) that may still be live.

item-type-per-app.title: Which itemType token each application's profile uses
item-type-per-app.detail: Only the Microsoft Login Services SDK example pairs an application with itemType tokens (see zia.tenant-profiles.microsoft). Nothing in the captured sources maps the other applications to a token; the Terraform provider deliberately does not validate the value. The legacy table that paired apps with tokens (Google/TENANT_RESTRICTION_DOMAIN, Slack/WORKSPACE_ID, GitHub/ENTERPRISE_SLUG, AWS/ACCOUNT_ID, Dropbox/TEAM_ID, Zoom/TENANT_ORG_ID) was inference from token names. Read an existing profile for the real pairing.
item-type-per-app.blocks: writing a profile for any application other than Microsoft without trial and error
